summary: Export host-owned live agent population, open attention counts, and snapshot freshness through OTLP

replay.detail: The exporter folds existing observations and authoritative source ownership; no replay or backfill is required.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or claim changes.

rules.detail: Runtime ownership, work assignment, suspension and attention lifecycle are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds st.agents, st.attention.open and st.agents.refresh.last_success on the daemon meter only when agent_population_enabled = true. Population uses exclusive state/reason buckets with unattributed evidence gaps, ten-minute empty retention, and current local membership plus live leased children. Attention emits all ten closed kinds including zeros. Repository attribution and underlying runtime evidence are consumed by the private population fold; metrics-only fields are not exposed on public agent resources.

downtime.detail: Ordinary daemon restart applies the deployment configuration; population export activates only when agent_population_enabled = true and the metrics pipeline is enabled. Population export defaults off.

manual.detail: The optional agent_population_repositories configuration contains at most eight canonical names and defaults to empty, preserving totals with unattributed repository labels. Review the shared daemon series allocation before rollout: the HTTP, mailbox and delivery allocation already exceeds the 2,000-series budget at 47 local members, before the new 267-series allocation. Export intervals must be no longer than five minutes.

recovery.detail: Before downgrading to an older strict config reader, remove agent_population_enabled and agent_population_repositories from the daemon configuration. Binary rollback then removes the new telemetry without modifying durable state.
